scope.en: After the September 16 update (UTC, official poster); exact opening hour not stated. Pass available until October 15, 04:59 (UTC+8).

identityBasis.en: Official CN and Global panels show the same male crown, ink landscape robe and blue iris shoulder/waist details; both identify it as a battle pass outfit. This is a visual and acquisition match, not a translated-name guess.
identityBasis.ko: 중국·글로벌 공식 이미지의 남성 관, 수묵 산수 도포, 어깨와 허리의 파란 붓꽃 장식을 대조했고 양쪽 모두 강호령 의상임을 확인했습니다. 번역명만으로 연결하지 않았습니다.

conditions.en: The announcement identifies the Battle Pass set; price and required reward level are not stated.
conditions.ko: 공식 공지에서 강호령 의상으로 소개했습니다. 가격과 필요한 보상 레벨은 미표기입니다.

description.en: A hairstyle and accessory set announced for Global on September 16 after the update (UTC). The CN edition includes dyeable hair, a hat, effect accessories, a face accessory and an animated avatar. Global pricing and individual included rewards have not yet been verified.
description.ko: 9월 16일 업데이트 후(UTC) 글로벌 출시 예정인 헤어·장신구 세트입니다. 중국 구성은 염색 가능한 헤어·모자·이펙트 장신구·얼굴 장식·동적 초상화이며, 글로벌의 개별 구성과 가격은 아직 확인 중입니다.

scope.en: After the September 16 version update (UTC); available until December 15, 2026 at 04:59 (UTC+8). Exact start hour is not stated.
scope.ko: 9월 16일 업데이트 후(UTC) 출시 예정, 2026년 12월 15일 04:59(UTC+8)까지. 정확한 시작 시각은 미표기입니다.

identityBasis.en: Matched the named CN and Global official artwork, including identical model, crown and ornaments.

conditions.en: Official Global post identifies a Draw set but does not state its currency, price, exchange quantity or individual included rewards. CN costs are not Global prices.

limitations: All new Global prices and currencies are unknown in these notices.
Korean expiry timezone is unstated, so preserve that limitation and use explicitly stated English UTC+8 where a normalized expiry is needed.
KR original artwork omits item labels; HTML section heading supplies the official Korean name.
Only 11 of 20 downloaded KR images were visually inspected; other files are available but must not be claimed verified.
X review was a scoped fresh search plus the new appearance post, not an exhaustive account export.
